name: Mui Ne
provinceNote: The coast account places this shore in Lam Dong. The food account and the 2018 tourism-zone decision still say Binh Thuan. The merger is dated 12 Jun 2025, and the new Mui Ne ward, dated 16 Jun 2025, joins the old Ham Tien ward, the old Mui Ne ward, and Thien Nghiep. The older ward is given as about 25,000 people, and as 24,275 in 1999 on 35.41 km². The merged ward is 50,166 people on 31 Dec 2024 across 118.59 km².
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: Red and white dunes, kitesurfing, and a fishing village on the sand near Phan Thiet. Ride the red dunes at sunset and the white dunes at dawn, kite on the Ham Tien beach, and eat seafood on the sea wall by the fishing village.
timeNeeded: A beach day, plus the dune dawn
fee: No single town ticket. Po Sah Inu catalogues list 7,000–15,000 VND. Dune tickets, a kite lesson, train fares, and taxi fares: Check on arrival.
getThere: About four hours by road from Ho Chi Minh City. The train ends at Phan Thiet.
seoTitle: Mui Ne travel guide — red and white dunes, kitesurfing, fishing village
seoDescription: Ride the red dunes at sunset and the white dunes at dawn, kite on Ham Tien, and eat on the sea wall by the fishing village.
intro: Mui Ne is the red dunes at sunset, the white dunes at dawn, a kite over the Ham Tien surf, and a fishing village on the sand. Sleep on the Ham Tien beach if the wind is why you came. That built sand is Rang. The fishing ward, with Ganh and Suoi Nuoc, sits farther along the bay.

Give the morning to the harbor if you are not leaving for the white dunes. The boats unload just after dawn, then cards and coffee once the catch is on the sand. A first kite lesson fits the gentler morning wind. The stronger thermal wind runs 11:00–16:00, with IKO instructors on the main beach strip. The kite season is October to April, the breeze is also described as year-round, and the dry coast months are November to April.

The red dunes are the late ride, just outside town: walk the orange slope and sandboard at sunset. Đồi cát bay sits in Mui Ne ward, about 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center, a field of about 36.8 ha, assigned since 2016 to the provincial youth outdoor center. The white field is Bàu Trắng, in Hoa Thang, the symbol of the national tourism zone. One distance is a 25 km drive. Another is a short drive from the main beach strip, with steep 30-metre dunes and a lotus lake. Be there from 5:00 to 7:00. Set the alarm for 4:30 if an ATV at sunrise is the plan. Midday sand is scorching.

Dinner is the sea wall by the fishing village. You pick from the tanks: fresh oysters, lemongrass clams, garlic scallops, grilled prawns, crispy fish, and chili stuffed squid, with beer. Nguyễn Đình Chiểu is the restaurant road from the center of Mui Ne toward the village, and Tuyên Quang is the other restaurant street. On the way in from Phan Thiet, the Po Sah Inu towers stand on Ba Nai Hill in Phu Hai, about 7 km northeast of the city center. The catalogues list 7,000–15,000 VND and do not split adult and child. Hours are 7:00–17:00 and 7:00–18:00. Between the strip and the dunes, the fairy stream is a shallow walk, called Suối Tiên and also Suối Hồng. Take your shoes off. It is ankle-deep, red clay and limestone on one side.
gettingAround: The strip is a road, not a grid you walk. A motorbike is the way to the dunes and the coast. Nguyễn Đình Chiểu (ĐT 706) and Võ Nguyên Giáp (ĐT 706B) tie Mui Ne to Phan Thiet. Võ Nguyên Giáp and provincial roads 715, 716, and 716B run along the north edge of the tourism zone.

From Ho Chi Minh City, count about four hours by road for this coast, and a four-hour taxi, bus, or car ride to Phan Thiet. Mui Ne is also given as four hours, and as 25 km past a four-hour Phan Thiet ride. The ward is about 22 km from Phan Thiet, and the flying dunes are about 22 km from the city center.

The train ends at Phan Thiet station, not in the fishing ward. From 11 Sep 2026 through 30 Dec 2026, SPT2 and SPT1 run Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. SPT2 leaves Saigon at 6:45 and reaches Phan Thiet at 10:42. SPT1 leaves Phan Thiet at 13:30 and reaches Saigon at 17:46. An earlier timetable has SPT2 into Phan Thiet at 10:40, and SPT1 leaving Phan Thiet at 13:10 and reaching Saigon at 17:35. Mui Ne is also an open-tour stop.

No civil passenger airport is open on this coast. Fly to Ho Chi Minh City, Nha Trang, or Da Lat, then a bus or a train. The civil terminal at Phan Thiet broke ground on 27 Apr 2026. The military side was already operating. A 2018 plan names Tan Son Nhat and Cam Ranh as the air links, and a Phan Thiet airport only after 2025.

stayAreas.name: Ham Tien sand
stayAreas.summary: Medium and small resorts sit in the Mui Ne–Ham Tien sea zone, about 340 ha on the 2018 plan. Smaller rooms are in the ward centers and the fishing village.

eat: Dinner is the sea wall by the fishing village. The local list starts with lẩu thả, mực một nắng, and the grill you pick from the tanks. Nguyễn Đình Chiểu and Tuyên Quang are the restaurant roads.
Twenty-eight plates are named, from the Mui Ne food list, the sea-wall grill, and the Binh Thuan coast menu.
interestsBody: The red slope is the sunset picture. Bàu Trắng is the dawn picture. The kite wind is on the Ham Tien sand. Eat on the sea wall by the fishing village, then along Nguyễn Đình Chiểu.
The night sits in the Mui Ne–Ham Tien sea zone. Po Sah Inu is the Cham stop on the road in from Phan Thiet, outside the fishing ward.

body: The lesson beach is the Ham Tien sand. The wind is gentler in the morning and stronger in the late afternoon. The thermal wind runs 11:00–16:00, October to April, with IKO instructors on the strip. The breeze is also described as year-round, and the dry coast months as November to April.

blocks.heading: Dawn boats
paragraphs: Just after dawn, stand out of the way at the fishing-village market while the boats unload. Cards and coffee follow once the catch is on the sand. Arrive at noon and that market is already over.

blocks.heading: Sea wall after dark
paragraphs: The evening area is the sea wall by the fishing village. You pick seafood from the tanks and eat on the wall: oysters, lemongrass clams, garlic scallops, grilled prawns, crispy fish, and chili stuffed squid, with beer.

blocks.heading: Nguyễn Đình Chiểu
paragraphs: Nguyễn Đình Chiểu runs from the center of Mui Ne toward the fishing village, and Tuyên Quang is the other street lined with rooms from cozy to cosmopolitan. The night activity sits in the Mui Ne sea zone.

cards.title: Wind on the strip
cards.summary: Ham Tien sand, a gentler morning lesson, and a stronger wind from 11:00 to 16:00.

interestGroups.title: The two dune fields
interestGroups.summary: For the sunset slope in the fishing ward, and the pale field at Hoa Thang before the heat.

blocks.heading: Red slope at the end of the day
paragraphs: Đồi cát bay is the orange field, just outside town, for the sunset walk and the sandboard. It covers about 36.8 ha in Mui Ne ward, about 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center, and since 2016 it has been assigned to the provincial youth outdoor center. The 22 km figure is from the city center.

blocks.heading: White field and the lake
paragraphs: Bàu Trắng is in Hoa Thang, Bac Binh, inside the national tourism zone, and it is the symbol of Mui Ne. Bàu Sen is named with it for protection. The field has steep 30-metre dunes and a lotus lake. Go from 5:00 to 7:00. One distance is a 25 km drive. Another is a short drive from the main beach strip.

blocks.heading: A shallow walk inland
paragraphs: The fairy stream sits under the Mui Ne sand hills. It is called Suối Tiên, and also Suối Hồng. Take your shoes off and walk upstream in ankle-deep water, red clay and limestone on one side. A coconut at a rest stop is part of the walk.

blocks.heading: Tower on the way in
paragraphs: Tháp Pô Sah Inư stands on Ba Nai Hill in Phu Hai, about 7 km northeast of Phan Thiet center, on the road between the city and the strip. The three brick towers are 1,200-year-old Hoa Lai national monuments. The main tower holds a Linga-Yoni altar. Three catalogues list 7,000–15,000 VND and do not split adult and child. Hours are 7:00–17:00 and 7:00–18:00. Addresses are given as a blank line, as Km9 Nguyễn Thông, Phường Phú Thuỷ, Lâm Đồng, and as Phường Phú Hài, Phan Thiết, Bình Thuận. The morning of 2 Oct 2024 was Katê at these towers.

faqs.a: On the Ham Tien sand if the kite and the resort row are the reason you came. Medium and small resorts fill the Mui Ne–Ham Tien sea zone, about 340 ha, with smaller rooms in the ward centers and the fishing village. The built sand west of the fishing ward is Rang Beach.

faqs.q: How do you get here from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Count about four hours by road. Phan Thiet is also given as four hours, with Mui Ne 25 km farther, and the ward as about 22 km from Phan Thiet. The train ends at Phan Thiet station. From 11 Sep 2026 through 30 Dec 2026, SPT2 and SPT1 run Friday, Saturday, and Sunday: Saigon 6:45, Phan Thiet 10:42, and back 13:30 to 17:46. An earlier timetable has 10:40 inbound and a return at 13:10–17:35.

The morning wind is gentler and the late afternoon is stronger. Kite winds are October to April, with the beach window at 11:00–16:00. The breeze is also described as year-round, and the dry coast months as November to April.

The red dunes are about 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center, and just outside town from the strip. The white dunes are a 25 km drive, and also a short drive from the main beach strip. Be at Bàu Trắng from 5:00 to 7:00.

season.label: Dry wind months
season.note: November to April is dry, sunny, and windy, the time for kites and dune slides. Kite winds are also October to April, with the beach window at 11:00–16:00, and the breeze and the water are described as warm year-round. December to April is the busy season, with an average around 27°C, and the coast is also described as warm sun all year at about 27°C. On the white dunes, go at 5:00–7:00. Midday sand is scorching.
